title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%).

declaredVenue: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
